description:
Orky Sector (Formally Looted Sector)

An orky starsector mod by Myco and Miko

Da Goffs are there to show all dat gitz who'z in charge!

WAAAGH!

Dependencies:

Lazy Lib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0

Magic Lib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25868.0

Graphic Lib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=10982.0

LunaLib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25658

Basic Nex Support

May 31 update, hotfixed, please download again if you downloaded it the earlier v0.71 updates

0.98 Version

Arma Addon - Require 0.98/latest Arma Version/Orky Sector V0.61+

0.97 Version

Older 0.53 ver available on github, v0.60/61 may work with mod_info swap but not extensively tested back on 0.98[/url]

NOTE:

May 13 V 0.70, Adding the Goff Clan, clan focused on vicious close range combat, with the most ramming ship amongst all clans, and various tweaks to some existing hullmods and ships

Showcase of Ships and Weapons (To be updated with latest stuff)

Spoiler

[close]

The Great Collapse brought a new threat to the now isolated sector, bands of a previously unheard of, green-skinned Alien race begin to attack explorers and scavengers on the fringe rim of the sectors. These vicious creature seems to be at first nothing more than pirates in ramshackle ships that should not even be able to fly, but quickly proven to be much more sophisticated than they first seem.

In the years that follows, these aliens have made their name as ruthless pirates and scavengers, however, they were, until now, a curious nuisance to the major powers of the sector. Whilst ork pirate bands have gotten larger and even mingled with some human pirates, they never had the ability to take on a military fleet head on.

That is about to change.

Features

A Mod that brings Orks from the 40k universe into the Persean Sector in a semi vanilla-friendly manner. This mod adds currently adds five ork factions (Death Skull/Evil Sunz/Bad Moons/Blood Axes/Goffs) with a series of both looted vanilla vessels and more original constructions, together with a corresponding set of Orky Hullmods, Weapons and LPCs. Come with lunalib option to add some lower end ork ship to pirate fleets.

The faction focuses on generally ramshackle ships that favors high speed, brutal close quarter combat and burst damage. (As any Evil Sunz will tell ya, Going fast and Krumpin' stuff iz da best!), however, each clan will also have their own focus, from the more high tech approach of the flashy bad moons to the brutal goffs who fight up close and personal.

Many weapon and hullmods having powerful or strange effects but also potentially deadly downsides. The ork's strange psychic ability improves the combat ability and reliability of ships in great numbers, making their otherwise ramshackle warship more effective in great swarms.

There are also a simple system where you can beat up orks to obtain teef, allowing you to use them to exchange for various benefit from the ork clans, as well as a small quest, serving as basis for a longer chain we will eventually work on.

By now, the five main clan are ready (snake bite will play a smaller role, but will be featured), the next step will be expanded the campaign level systems such as teef shop and quests, but also touch up some of the older ships from the first few clans to make them a bit more unique.  :D

Some Design Thoughts

Turns out translating a bunch of mod gets one interested in trying to do some modding of their own. As a long time warhammer fan and ork player almost two decades, trying to bring the Orks to the Sector seems like a great

excuse towards my limited spriting skills

place to start!

There have been some excellent junker ship styles on the forums, and I thought to take a slightly different approach by focusing on the diversity of both fighting style and paintjob provided by the various Ork Clans in the setting, as a result this mod will be a bit more focused on bringing that aspect of Orky Kultur to the sector.

This is a Starsector mod first and foremost and I will not be strictly adhering to Battlefleet Gothic and 40k lore, and there will be some liberty in how I inject some proppa orkiness into the game, but I do hope you can find some good ol' orky fun within. This is our first starsector mod so any feedback and comment are appreciated as well.  :D

Some Previews of Orky Stuff in Action

Changelog

Version 0.71 Update

HOTFIX May 31st

Fixed a crash in ground battle with orks.

Fixed a potential issue with loading 0.70 saves

Giga ramma range 300 -250

Terror (Goff) DP 14-12

Added a bit of knockback and self damage. to Stormnob hammer

Stompa Belly Armor - gives 30% extra front armor instead of 100 flat

Stompa Horned Heads armor 75 -> 100, also give 20% system CD reduction.

Belly Hanger -> cooldown 5s - 8s

Belly Lobba -> Cooldown 1.5 - 1.25

Fixed typo on broadside gunz/effect not functioning

Fixed issue various issue with giga ramma's module movement.

Fixed issue with Invictus module and shield radius causing mine to spawn on top

Fixed stompa head still dropping

Version 0.70 Goff Update

New Additions

Added Golf Clan, with its own system, 19 ships, 4LPC and 6 clan-specific weapons.

Added 3 Generic LPC from storm boyz to deffkoptas

Changes

Boarding Pod Now stick to target, duration reduced 15 -10 , Damage reduced. Mobility Reduced for regular version.

Tweaked Ramma AI to be potentially more aggressive than before

Supa-Overdrive reworked, removed weapon damage buff, added various client-specific buffs instead.

Ard case armor increase becomes percent based + smaller flat value

Grot Oiler Refit Decrease Rate Debuff 20 -> 15%

Grot Rigger Max Repair Amount 40% - 50% of HP /750-1000 HP

Ard Field Zzap range increased to 1000

Loadsa Generata - Base and Shield Shunt Shield Bonus Timeflow Halved, shield bonus reduced 0.25 -> 0.1, base ship shield improved.

Compact TPC - OP 18-16

Krima (BM) DP - 8 - 10 , shield efficiency 1 -> 0.9

Fixes

Melee Weapon Range code improved to avoid unwanted range modification to melee weapon. -> Certain listener modification, notably, ballistic range finder, may still affect them.

Fixed gitgrod conversation can be triggered repeatedly.

Fixed BA rotary krusha tag causing it to show up as drops.

Fixed bug where you can built-in supa-overdrive, can no longer be built-in

Restricted Tags added to teef shop weapon to prevent unwanted appearnce.

Mob Rule Description revised to provide total amount of ship providing bonus

Changed Default Ship Role for better distribution, hopefully reducing too much ork ships in pirate fleets with Orky Pirate on.

Jan 24 V0.621 Update

New

Swapped Sprite/Name for Lambda Bounty

Added Gorslag Cruiser

Changes

Stompa Factory HP 24000 ->20000 , DP 45 -50

Parked Stompa Armor 500-400

Smol Rok Base Armor 400 ->300

Gouga Armor 1000->900, DP 9 - 10

Bone Breaka Armor 1100->1000, DP 9 - 10

Gold Tooth DP 11-12 armor 650 -600

Deff Dreads number 2->1, most weapon performance improved, except mega blasta rof reduced 3.75-4.75.

Ramma - Removed HE damager reduction effect, to compensate, further reduced damage taken from Ship Explosion. Ramma ship also explode for less damage.

Krump Da Gitz!! System - Dmg reduction 33 - 25% , mass increase greatly reduced. Speed Increase now percent based, overall slowed down, in particular for slower ships

Road to Waaagh battle adjusted to limit max FP of the target fleet.

Fixes

Fixed some text

Stompa Factory should be always recoverable

V0.62 Release

New

Added 4 Stompas, one for each clan, with customizable arm, head, and belly weapons.

Added 3 more ships, included first of introduction of Goffs (currently only available in Quests/Pirates (If Orky Pirate is turned on)

Added a small quest line (triggered by visiting any planet after patching)

Changes

Deth Kannon Shell get new sprite

Move Melee Modifier Listener to Base Mod, from Arma Addon

Krusha ROF 2 - 2.75 , Krusha Battery 2.5 - 2.75

Stikk Bomma - Ammo limit replaced with clip , overall significantly slower firing.

Mega Bolta Slightly Increased Recoil 2 - 2.5

Ded Sneaking Duration increased 4- 4.5 , recharge rate 0.05 - 0.075

Lead Belcher dissipation 180 - 150

Bloodfang Flux 3600 - 4200 , diss 240 -275

Rok module - banned converted hanger,unstable injector, orky override, synchornized effect of supa overload, set to drone.

Rok - banned unstable injector

Slightly Improved reward of new questline compared to test release.

Fixes

Fix boarding pod incorrectly affecting dmg reduction for automated ships

Fixed Built-in super shoota and deff dread mega blasta being in BP pack

Various text fix

V0.61

Fixed Tag for Deffgun
